paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise requires, "G-III," "Company," "us," "we" and "our" refer to G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. and its subsidiaries. References to fiscal years refer to the year ended or ending on January 31 of that year. For example, our fiscal year ended January 31, 2026 is referred to as "fiscal 2026."
G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. is a Delaware corporation that was formed in 1989. We and our predecessors have conducted our business since 1974.

G-III is a global leader in fashion with expertise in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, which enables us to fuel growth across a portfolio of over 30 globally recognized owned and licensed brands, anchored by our key owned brands DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld and Vilebrequin. We develop products across a diverse range of lifestyle categories which include outerwear, dresses, sportswear, suit separates, athleisure, jeans, swimwear, as well as handbags, footwear, small leather goods, cold weather accessories and luggage. Our brands are positioned to sell at various price points with global distribution across a diverse mix of channels and geographies to reach a broad range of consumers.

G-III's success is driven by our expertise and ability to leverage our best-in-class capabilities and strong corporate foundation to enable our heritage and emerging fashion brands to reach their full potential at scale. With a merchant-driven philosophy, we create compelling fashion that meets the needs of the market and resonate with global consumers across categories, channels and geographies. G-III's highly developed infrastructure in design and sourcing, combined with our well-established relationships with manufacturers and retailers, enables us to deliver significant value to our partners and quickly bring product to market. This formula, powered by our talented team and financial strength, drives long-term brand potential.
We currently market apparel and other products under, among others, the following owned and licensed brand names:

We own and operate a portfolio of proprietary leading fashion brands that are central to our growth strategy. These brands are sold across a range of distribution channels at wholesale and through our own digital platforms and retail stores. Through our marketing efforts, we are focused on building brand equity and global recognition to grow these businesses for the long-term. Additionally, we strategically license our proprietary brands in complementary categories and

geographies to selected partners. Our owned brands include DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld, Vilebrequin, Eliza J, Jessica Howard, Andrew Marc, G.H. Bass, Wilsons Leather and Sonia Rykiel. Our owned brands accounted for approximately 57% of our net sales in fiscal 2026, 52% of our net sales in fiscal 2025 and 47% of our net sales in fiscal 2024.

● DKNY – Founded in 1989 and acquired by G-III in 2016, DKNY is a global fashion brand recognized for modern tailoring and sophisticated ease that reflects the spirit of New York. We distribute a full lifestyle assortment across premier department stores, DKNY stores and digital platforms, partner operated stores, and online retailers. The brand operates more than 70 stores worldwide, including 13 company operated stores, strategically concentrated in premium outlets and international partner markets, while driving scale through broad wholesale distribution. We license DKNY across key categories—including fragrance, men's, kids, home, eyewear, watches and other accessories, which expands brand reach and contributes incremental royalty income. DKNY net sales were approximately $650 million in fiscal 2026, $675 million in fiscal 2025 and $590 million in fiscal 2024.

● Donna Karan – After acquiring Donna Karan in 2016, G-III relaunched the brand in North America in Spring 2024. The new Donna Karan offers a modern system of dressing created to appeal to a woman's senses on every level, addressing the full lifestyle needs of a new consumer. Inspired by the Donna Karan archives, we have thoughtfully created a new product line that captures the brand's ethos of timeless elegance, empowering women and accessible luxury, tailored to meet the lifestyle needs of today's customer. The brand is currently distributed across premier North American department stores as well as online through marketplace partner platforms and our owned Donna Karan digital site. We are in the early stages of further developing the brand's lifestyle offerings. The brand is generating significant profitability with some of the highest average unit retails ("AURs") and sell-throughs across our portfolio.

headings: Risk Factors Relating to Our Wholesale Operations
The failure to maintain or renew our material license agreements could cause us to lose significant revenues and have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.
Our success is dependent on the strategies and reputation of our licensors.
Our business and the success of our products could be harmed if we are unable to maintain or enhance the images of our proprietary brands.
Use of social media and influencers may adversely affect our reputation or subject our proprietary brands to fines or other penalties.
We have significant customer concentration, and a reduction in purchases or the loss of one of our large customers could adversely affect our business.
Risks Relating to Our Retail Operations
Our retail operations may continue to incur losses if our retail turnaround strategy does not significantly improve the results of operations of our retail business.
Leasing of significant amounts of real estate exposes us to possible liabilities and losses.

Our retail stores are heavily dependent on the ability and desire of consumers to travel and shop. A reduction in the volume of outlet mall traffic or the closing of outlet malls could adversely affect our retail sales.
Our digital business faces distinct risks, and our failure to successfully manage this business could have a negative impact on our profitability.
Risk Factors Relating to the Operation of Our Business
If we lose the services of our key personnel, or are unable to attract key personnel, our business will be harmed.
We may need additional financing to continue to grow.
Our business is highly seasonal.
Extreme or unseasonable weather conditions could adversely affect our business.
Our ability to deliver our products to the market could be disrupted if we encounter problems affecting our logistics and distribution systems.
Supply chain disruptions have adversely affected, and could continue to adversely affect, our ability to import our products in a timely manner and our freight costs.
Fluctuations in the price, availability and quality of materials used in our products could have a material adverse effect on our cost of goods sold and our ability to meet our customers' demands.
If we inadequately protect, maintain and enforce our trademark and other intellectual property rights, or infringe the intellectual property rights of third parties, our business could be harmed.
We are subject to the risk that our partners may not generate expected sales or maintain the value of our brands.
Risk Factors Relating to the Economy and the Apparel Industry
Recent and future economic conditions, including volatility in the financial and credit markets, inflation and increases in interest rates, may adversely affect our business.
The cyclical nature of the apparel industry and uncertainty over future economic prospects and consumer spending could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.
The competitive nature of our industry may result in lower prices for our products and decreased gross profit margins.
If major department, mass merchant and specialty store chains consolidate, continue to close stores or cease to do business, our business could be negatively affected.
The effects of war, conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, acts of terrorism, natural disasters or public health crises could adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Risks Related to Our International Operations
We are dependent upon foreign manufacturers and our arrangements with them subject us to risks, including potential import restrictions, duties and tariffs.
We have foreign currency exposures relating to buying and selling in currencies other than the U.S. dollar, our functional currency.
We are subject to numerous risks associated with international operations.
Risks Related to Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Information Technology
Laws on privacy continue to evolve, and place further limits on how we collect or use customer information could adversely affect our business.

We are subject to rules relating to the processing of credit card payments. Failure to comply with these rules could result in an ability to process payments which would adversely affect our retail business.
paragraphs: The following risk factors should be read carefully in connection with evaluating our business and the forward-looking statements contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Any of the following risks could materially adversely affect our business, our prospects, our operating results, our financial condition, the trading prices of our securities and the actual outcome of matters as to which forward-looking statements are made in this report. Additional risks that we do not yet know of or that we currently think are immaterial may also affect our business operations. The risks discussed below also include forward-looking statements, and our actual results may differ substantially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements.

We are dependent on sales of licensed products for a substantial portion of our revenues. In fiscal 2026, net sales of licensed product accounted for 43.0% of our net sales compared to 48.0% of our net sales in fiscal 2025 and 53.4% of our net sales in fiscal 2024.

We are generally required to achieve specified minimum net sales, make specified royalty and advertising payments and receive prior approval from the licensor as to all design and other elements of each product prior to production. License agreements also may restrict our ability to enter into other license agreements for competing products or acquire businesses that produce competing products without the consent of the licensor. If we do not satisfy any of the material requirements of a license agreement or receive approval with respect to a restricted transaction, a licensor may have the right to terminate our license and seek damages. Even if a licensor does not terminate our license, the failure to achieve net sales sufficient to cover our required minimum royalty payments could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations. If a license contains a renewal option, there are usually minimum net sales and other conditions that must be met in order to be able to renew. If a license does not contain a renewal option, and we desire to renew the license, we must negotiate renewal terms with the licensor. However, even if we comply with all of the terms of a license agreement, we cannot guarantee that we will be able to renew an agreement when it expires even if we desire to do so as a licensor may decide to manufacture the licensed products itself or engage a new licensee for the products. The failure to maintain or renew our material license agreements could cause us to lose significant revenue and have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.

We strive to offer our products on a multiple brand, multiple channel and multiple price point basis. As a part of this strategy, we license the names and brands of numerous recognized companies and designers. In entering into these license agreements, we plan our products to be targeted towards different market segments based on consumer demographics, design, suggested pricing and channel of distribution. In addition to granting us licenses to produce and sell products, our licensors typically produce and sell their own products and may also grant licenses to third parties to produce and sell products. If any of our licensors decides to "reposition" its products under the brands we license from them, introduce similar products under similar brand names or otherwise change the parameters of design, pricing, distribution, target market or competitive set, we could experience a significant downturn in that brand's business, adversely affecting our sales and profitability. Further, we are unable to control the quality of the products produced by our licensors and their other licensees. If they do not maintain the quality of their goods, the brand image may be adversely affected, which could also affect our sales and profitability. In addition, as licensed products may be personally associated with designers, our sales of those products could be materially and adversely affected if any of those individuals' images, reputations or popularity were to be negatively impacted.

The growth of our proprietary brands, their favorable images and our customers' connection to our brands has contributed to our success. Our proprietary brands include DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, G.H. Bass, Vilebrequin, Sonia Rykiel, Andrew Marc and Wilsons Leather. In addition, brand value is based in part on consumer perceptions of a variety of qualities, including merchandise quality and corporate integrity. Negative claims or publicity regarding G-III, our brands, our products or the failure, on the part of G-III or our employees, to maintain the safety, integrity and ethics standards that we set for our operations, as well as those expected of members of our industry, could adversely affect our reputation and sales regardless of whether such claims are accurate. Social media, which accelerates the dissemination of information, can increase the challenges of responding to negative claims. Social media influencers or other endorsers of our products could engage in behavior that reflects poorly on our brands and may be attributed to us or otherwise adversely affect us. In addition, as certain of our brands may be personally associated with designers, our sales of those products could be materially and adversely affected if any of those individuals' images, reputations or popularity were to be negatively impacted. Any harm to our brands or reputation could adversely affect our business, results of operations or financial condition.

Our proprietary brands use third-party social media platforms as, among other things, marketing tools. We also maintain relationships with social media influencers and engage in collaborations. If we are unable to cost-effectively use social media platforms as marketing tools or if the social media platforms we use change their policies or algorithms, we may not be able to fully optimize such platforms, and our ability to maintain and acquire consumers and our financial condition may suffer. Our relationships with influencers may not have the desired effect, and information posted on social media platforms may be adverse to our reputation or business.

paragraphs: Effective February 2026, we entered into a license agreement with French Connection Limited to design and produce women's and men's apparel (subject to certain exclusions), women's and men's outerwear, handbags and men's footwear under the French Connection brand. The license agreement includes an initial term of five-years with an option to renew for an additional five-year term. The products produced under this license agreement are expected to be distributed in North America through our diversified distribution network, including premier department stores, digital channels, as well as other channels. First deliveries of our French Connection product began in February 2026 for Spring 2026. We believe that significant opportunity exists in the categories subject to this license agreement where we have strong expertise, and the products expected to be produced align with G-III's core competencies.
We report based on two segments: wholesale operations and retail operations.

Our wholesale operations segment includes sales of products to retailers under owned, licensed and private label brands, as well as sales related to the Karl Lagerfeld and Vilebrequin businesses, including from retail stores operated by Vilebrequin and Karl Lagerfeld, other than sales of product under the Karl Lagerfeld Paris brand generated by our retail stores and digital sites. Wholesale revenues also include royalty revenues from license agreements related to our owned trademarks including DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld, G.H. Bass, Andrew Marc, Vilebrequin and Sonia Rykiel in product categories we do not produce ourselves.

Our retail operations segment consists primarily of direct sales to consumers through our company operated stores and product sales through our digital sites for the DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, G.H. Bass and Wilsons Leather

brands. As of January 31, 2026, our retail operations segment consisted of 47 company operated stores for our DKNY and Karl Lagerfeld Paris brands, substantially all of which are operated as outlet stores in North America.

paragraphs: 除非文意另有所指，"G-III," "Company," "us," "we" 以及 "our" 均指 G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. 及其子公司。提及財務年度時，均指該年度 1 月 31 日為結算日。例如，我們財務年度於 2026 年 1 月 31 日結算，則稱為 "財務 2026"。
G-III Apparel Group, Ltd. 為一間設立於特拉華州的公司，於 1989 年成立。我們與我們的前身自 1974 年起便從事相關業務。

G-III 是全球時尚產業的領導者，具備設計、採購、流通與行銷方面的專業知識，使我們能於擁有超過 30 個 globally recognized 自有品牌與授權品牌的產品組閤中推動成長，其中以我們的重要自有品牌 DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld 與 Vilebrequin 為核心。我們開發的產品涵蓋多樣化的時尚類別，包括外套、連身裙、休閒服、西裝單件、運動休閒服、牛仔褲、泳裝，以及手提包、鞋類、小皮件、冬季配件與行李箱。我們的品牌定位於不同價格區間，透過多樣化的通路與地理區域進行全球銷售，以觸及廣泛的消費者羣。

G-III 的成功取決於我們的專業知識與能力，能善用我們最佳的專業能力與強固的企業基礎，使我們的傳統與新興時尚品牌能於規模上實現其最大潛力。以零售商驅動的哲學為基礎，我們創造出符合市場需求且能與全球消費者產生共鳴的時尚產品，橫跨各類別、通路與地理區域。G-III 在設計與採購方面的高度發達基礎，結合我們與製造商與零售商之間長期建立的關係，使我們能為合作夥伴創造顯著價值，並迅速將產品推向市場。此模式，由我們優秀的團隊與財務實力所支撐，推動品牌的長期潛力。
我們目前在以下自有與授權品牌名稱下行銷服裝及其他產品：
​ ​ ​ Team Sports Andrew Marc BCBG Collegiate Licensing Company DKNY Calvin Klein Major League Baseball
Donna Karan Champion National Basketball Association Eliza J Cole Haan National Football League
G.H. Bass Converse National Hockey League G-III Sports by Carl Banks Dockers Starter Jessica Howard
French Connection Karl Lagerfeld Halston Karl Lagerfeld Paris Kenneth Cole Marc New York Kensie
Sonia Rykiel Levi's Vilebrequin Margaritaville Wilsons Leather Nautica Tommy Hilfiger Vince Camuto
本公司擁有並經營一組自有智慧財產權的領導時尚品牌，這些品牌是本公司成長策略的核心。這些品牌透過各類通路進行批發銷售，並透過本公司自有數位平台及零售門市進行銷售。透過行銷努力，本公司致力於建立品牌價值與全球認知度，以長遠發展這些業務。此外，本公司亦策略性地將自有品牌授權給相關產業及地理區域的選定合作夥伴。

本公司自有品牌包括 DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld、Vilebrequin、Eliza J、Jessica Howard、Andrew Marc、G.H. Bass、Wilsons Leather 及 Sonia Rykiel。本公司自有品牌在財務年度 2026 的淨銷售額佔比約為 57%，在財務年度 2025 的淨銷售額佔比約為 52%，在財務年度 2024 的淨銷售額佔比約為 47%。

● DKNY – 於 1989 年成立，並於 2016 年被 G-III 收購，DKNY 是一個全球時尚品牌，以現代剪裁與簡約優雅風格聞名，反映紐約的精神。本公司透過首爾百貨公司、DKNY 門市、數位平台、合作經營門市及線上零售商進行全生活風格商品的銷售。該品牌在全球擁有超過 70 門市，包括 13 門市為本公司自行經營，這些門市策略性地集中在高檔折扣中心及國際合作市場，同時透過廣泛的批發銷售來擴大規模。本公司將 DKNY 授權至多個商品類別，包括香水、男裝、兒童服飾、家居用品、眼鏡、手錶及其他配件，這有助於擴展品牌影響力並增加 royalty 收入。DKNY 的淨銷售額在財務年度 2026 約為 650 百萬美元，在財務年度 2025 約為 675 百萬美元，在財務年度 2024 約為 590 百萬美元。

● Donna Karan – 本公司於 2016 年取得 Donna Karan 品牌，並於 2024 年春季重新推出該品牌於北美市場。新推出的 Donna Karan 提供一種現代化的服裝系統，旨在觸動女性的多重感官，滿足新消費者的全方位生活需求。靈感來自 Donna Karan 的歷史設計，本公司精心打造了新的產品線，傳達該品牌的永恆優雅、賦予女性力量與可負擔的奢華風格，以符合當前消費者的生活需求。目前該品牌透過北美首爾百貨公司進行銷售，並透過市場合作平台及本公司自有 Donna Karan 數位網站進行線上銷售。本公司目前正處於進一步發展該品牌生活風格產品的初期階段。該品牌已產生顯著的獲利能力，並在本公司品牌組閤中擁有最高的平均單價（"AURs"）及銷售率（sell-throughs）。

paragraphs: 自2026年2月起，本公司與French Connection Limited簽訂授權協議，設計與製造婦女及男性服裝（特定除外情形除外）、婦女及男性外套、手提包及男性鞋類，品牌為French Connection。此授權協議包含初始五年期，並有選擇續約五年期的選項。根據此授權協議所製造的產品預期將透過本公司多元化的通路網路於北美地區發貨，包括首爾百貨公司、數位通路及其他通路。本公司French Connection產品的首次發貨於2026年2月開始，為2026年春季產品。本公司認為在本授權協議所涉及的產品類別中，有顯著的商機，而預期製造的產品與G-III的核心競爭優勢相符。
本公司依兩大分部進行報告： Wholesale operations（批發業務）及Retail operations（零售業務）。

本公司 Wholesale operations（批發業務）分部包含向零售商銷售產品，品牌為本公司自有品牌、授權品牌及自有標籤品牌，以及與Karl Lagerfeld及Vilebrequin業務相關的銷售，包括由Vilebrequin及Karl Lagerfeld經營的零售商店銷售，但不包含由本公司零售商店及數位網站銷售的Karl Lagerfeld Paris品牌產品。 Wholesale收入亦包含來自與本公司自有商標（包括DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld、G.H. Bass、Andrew Marc、Vilebrequin及Sonia Rykiel）授權協議的 royalty 收入，涉及本公司未自行製造的產品類別。
本公司 Retail operations（零售業務）分部主要為本公司直接向消費者銷售產品，透過本公司經營的商店及數位網站銷售DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld Paris、G.H. Bass及Wilsons Leather品牌產品。
截至2026年1月31日，本公司Retail operations（零售業務）分部包含47家本公司經營的商店，為DKNY及Karl Lagerfeld Paris品牌，其中絕大部分為位於北美地區的折扣商店。

headings: 風險因素與我們的通路業務相關
未能維持或更新我們的重要授權契約，可能會導致我們失去重大收入，並對我們的營運結果產生重大不利影響。
我們的成功取決於我們授權方的策略與聲譽。
若我們無法維持或提升我們自有品牌的形象，將可能影響我們的業務與產品的表現。
使用社交媒體與影響者可能會對我們的聲譽造成不利影響，或使我們的自有品牌面臨罰款或其他處罰。
我們有相當程度的客戶集中度，若購買量減少或失去其中一位大型客戶，可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
與我們零售業務相關的風險
我們的零售業務可能持續虧損，若我們的零售扭轉策略未能顯著改善零售業務的營運結果。
租賃大量實物資產可能使我們面臨潛在的責任與損失。
我們的零售商店嚴重依賴消費者旅行與購物的意願與能力。出入口商場人流量減少或出入口商場關閉，可能對我們的零售銷售造成不利影響。
我們的數位業務面臨獨特的風險，若我們未能成功經營此業務，可能對我們的獲利能力產生負面影響。
與我們業務運作相關的風險因素
若我們失去關鍵人員的服務，或無法吸引關鍵人員，將會對我們的業務造成損害。
我們可能需要額外資金以持續成長。
我們的業務具有高度季節性。
極端或不尋常的天氣條件可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
本公司能否將產品送達市場，若遭遇影響物流及配送系統的問題，可能會受到幹擾。
供應鏈中斷已對本公司及可能持續對本公司影響，使產品及時進口的能力受損，並增加運輸費用。
產品所使用材料的價格、可得性及品質波動，可能對本公司成本及滿足客戶需求的能力產生重大不利影響。
若本公司未能妥善保護、維護及執行本公司商標及其他智慧財產權，或侵犯第三方智慧財產權，本公司業務可能會受到損害。
本公司面臨的風險為：合作夥伴可能無法達成預期銷售額或維持本公司品牌的價值。
與總體經濟及服飾產業相關的風險因素
近期及未來的經濟狀況，包括金融與信貸市場的波動、通貨膨脹及利率上漲，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
服飾產業的週期性及未來經濟前景與消費者支出的不確定性，可能對本公司營運成果產生重大不利影響。
我們產業的競爭性可能導致我們產品的價格下降及毛利率降低。
若主要百貨公司、量販店及專賣店連鎖通路持續合併、關閉門市或停止營業，將可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
戰爭、烏克蘭與中東地區衝突、恐怖攻擊、自然災害或公共衛生危機等事件，可能對我們的業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
與國際業務相關的風險
我們依賴海外製造商，且與其的安排使我們面臨風險，包括可能的進口限制、關稅及稅費。
我們因以美元以外的貨幣進行買賣，而產生外幣風險，且美元為我們的記帳貨幣。
我們面臨與國際業務相關的多重風險。
與網路安全、資料隱私權及資訊科技相關的風險
隱私權相關法規持續演進，並對我們收集或使用客戶資訊的方式設下更多限制，可能會對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司受信用卡付款處理相關規則所規範。未能遵守這些規則可能會導致無法處理付款，進而對本公司零售業務產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素應謹慎閱讀，以評估我們的業務及本年度報告表10-K中所包含的預測性陳述。任何上述風險都可能對我們的業務、前景、營運結果、財務狀況、證券交易價格及預測性陳述中所提及事項的實際結果造成重大不利影響。我們可能尚不知曉的其他風險，或目前認為不重要的風險，也可能影響我們的業務運作。下列討論的風險也包含預測性陳述，我們的實際結果可能與這些預測性陳述中所討論的結果有顯著差異。
我們的收入有相當大一部分取決於授權產品的銷售。在會計年度2026年，授權產品的淨銷售額佔我們淨銷售額的43.0%，與會計年度2025年的48.0%及會計年度2024年的53.4%相比。

我們通常必須達成指定的最低淨銷售額，支付指定的版稅及廣告費用，並在生產前獲得授權方對所有產品設計及其他元素的批准。授權協議也可能限制我們在未獲得授權方同意的情況下，與其他授權方簽訂競爭產品的授權協議或收購生產競爭產品的企業。如果我們未能符合任何授權協議的關鍵要求或未獲得受限制交易的批准，授權方可能有權終止我們的授權並要求賠償。即使授權方未終止我們的授權，未能達成足夠的淨銷售額以覆蓋我們所需的最低版稅支付，也可能對我們的營運結果造成重大不利影響。如果授權協議包含續約選項，通常必須達成最低淨銷售額及其他條件才能續約。如果授權協議不包含續約選項，而我們希望續約，必須與授權方協商續約條款。然而，即使我們符合授權協議的所有條款，我們無法保證在合約到期時能成功續約，即使我們希望續約，因為授權方可能決定自行製造授權產品或委託新的授權方製造產品。未能維持或續約我們的重要授權協議，可能導致我們失去大量收入，並對我們的營運結果造成重大不利影響。

我們致力於以多品牌、多通路及多價位策略提供產品。作為此策略的一部分，我們授權許多知名公司及設計師的名稱與品牌。在簽訂這些授權協議時，我們會根據消費者人口統計、設計、建議售價及通路分銷，規劃產品針對不同的市場區段。除了授予我們製造與銷售產品的授權外，我們的授權方通常也會製造與銷售他們自己的產品，並可能授予第三方製造與銷售產品的授權。如果任何我們的授權方決定在其品牌下重新定位其產品、推出相似產品或以其他方式改變設計、售價、分銷、目標市場或競爭對手的參數，我們可能在該品牌的業務上遭遇顯著下滑，不利於我們的銷售與獲利。此外，我們無法控制授權方及其其他授權方所製造產品的品質。如果他們未能維持產品品質，品牌形象可能受到不利影響，這也可能影響我們的銷售與獲利。此外，由於授權產品可能與設計師個人有關聯，如果任何這些個人的聲譽、聲望或人氣受到負面影響，我們銷售這些產品的業務可能受到重大且不利的影響。

我們自有品牌的成長、其正面形象及客戶對品牌的連結，已促成我們的成功。我們的自有品牌包括DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld、Karl Lagerfeld Paris、G.H. Bass、Vilebrequin、Sonia Rykiel、Andrew Marc及Wilsons Leather。此外，品牌價值部分取決於消費者對多種品質的觀感，包括產品品質與企業誠信。針對G-III、我們的品牌、我們的產品或G-III或我們員工未能維持我們對運營所設定的安全、誠信與道德標準，以及產業界所預期的標準，所產生的負面聲譽或報導，可能對我們的聲譽與銷售造成不利影響，不管這些聲譽或報導是否準確。社交媒體加速資訊的傳播，可能增加我們應對負面聲譽的挑戰。社交媒體影響者或其他產品代言人可能從事對我們品牌不利的行為，可能被歸咎於我們或以其他方式對我們造成不利影響。此外，由於某些我們的品牌可能與設計師個人有關聯，如果任何這些個人的聲譽、聲望或人氣受到負面影響，我們銷售這些產品的業務可能受到重大且不利的影響。任何對我們品牌或聲譽的損害，可能對我們的業務、營運結果或財務狀況造成不利影響。
我們的自有品牌使用第三方社交媒體平台作為行銷工具之一。我們也與社交媒體影響者維持關係並進行合作。如果我們無法以成本效益的方式使用社交媒體平台作為行銷工具，或社交媒體平台改變其政策或演算法，我們可能無法完全發揮這些平台的潛力，導致我們維持與獲取消費者的能力及財務狀況受損。我們與影響者之間的關係可能無法達到預期效果，且社交媒體平台上發布的資訊可能對我們的聲譽或業務造成不利影響。
